title: Unit Administration Services by Program Tier — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Unit Administration Services — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

Administrative services and requirements attached to each unit leased under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, by program tier.

## Registration, insurance and unit substitution

| Program tier | Kestrel renews registrations and bills the fees at cost | Administrative fee per registration renewal handled by Kestrel (USD) | Minimum combined single limit auto liability the business must carry (USD) | Unit may be swapped for a replacement under the same schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | No | 0 | 1000000 | No |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | No | 0 | 1000000 | No |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | Yes | 15 | 1000000 | No |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | Yes | 12.5 | 2000000 | Yes |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | Yes | 10 | 2000000 | Yes |
| Kestrel National Fleet | Yes | 7.5 | 5000000 | Yes |

## Requirements common to every tier

| Item | Every program tier |
|---|---|
| Delivery and acceptance certificate to be signed after delivery | within 5 calendar days |
| Monthly fee per unit when Kestrel places insurance after a lapse | 165 USD |

## Reading the table

- Registration renewal by Kestrel is a service of Kestrel Fleet Preferred and the tiers above it; in Kestrel Business Advantage and Kestrel Fleet Select it is not offered and its fee is 0.
- Unit substitution under the same schedule is available from Kestrel Fleet Premier upward.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Fleet Premier business carrying 1500000 of combined single limit liability is below that tier's 2000000 minimum; the same coverage meets the 1000000 minimum of Kestrel Fleet Preferred.
